scope: Oracle-only mechanical export of all 15 actual Curl retry records. The reload20 phase schema is extended with per-exchange delay_ms, complete files_before_response and preserved directory entries. Actual argv retains -q and every public option; stdin is bound to the exact executed probe. Each exchange is an actual oracle request and response, with original request-line/Host/Cookie and raw header bytes. Replays must reject any additional request or missing expected request. The unused supplied response suffix remains source evidence, never an invented exchange. Complete before-response and terminal file inventories include directory sentinels; immediate after-write snapshots remain only in the original raw report because they are not atomic client-flush observations. No candidate-derived expected value, new artifact acceptance or complete retry grammar claim.
